v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: Blessed are all * they that fear the Lord. ‡
Let them all be confounded * who hate Sion.

text.la: De profúndis * clamávi ad te, Dómine. ‡
text.en: Out of the depths * I have cried to thee, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * non est exaltátum cor meum. ‡
text.en: O Lord * my heart is not exalted. ‡

text.la: Elégit Dóminus * Sion in habitatiónem sibi.
text.en: The Lord hath chosen * Sion for his dwelling.

text.la: Non auferétur sceptrum de Iuda, et dux de fémore eius, donec véniat qui mitténdus est; et ipse erit exspectátio géntium.
text.en: The sceptre shall not be taken away from Juda, nor a ruler from his thigh, till he comes that is to be sent, and he shall be the expectation of nations.

v.la: Roráte, cæli, désuper, et nubes pluant iustum.
v.en: Drop down dew, ye heavens, from above, and let the clouds rain the Just.

r.en: Let the earth be opened, and bud forth the Saviour.

text.la: Ecce ancílla Dómini: * fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum.
text.en: Behold the handmaid * of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word.

text.la: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut redemptiónis nostræ ventúra solémnitas et præséntis nobis vitæ subsídia cónferat, et ætérnæ beatitúdinis prǽmia largiátur.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that the solemn Feast of our redemption, which is now at hand, may both help us in the life which now is, and further us toward the attaining of thine eternal joy in that which is to come.
